title: The Chalkbone Helm
summary: Something to wear out of the Rings, a helm to finish what the plate started.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now work a chalkbone bar and chalk moth dust into a helm, finishing the set: the plate, the greaves, the gauntlets, the boots, and now this.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking chalk moth dust, for anyone who would rather buy the padding than fight a moth for it.

items.name: Chalkbone helm
items.examine: Chalkbone curved to the skull, packed inside with moth dust for whatever padding that is worth.
